# Multiable aiM18 HCM | Product Overview

Multiable aniM18 HCM is an Asia-Pacific localized HCM and low-code enterprise platform covering core personnel, remuneration, talent and analysis. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
